name: change
title: change!
blurb: a port of GamesCrafters' Change! — a 14-point sliding board where 3 pieces a side slide forward-only, win by occupying the opponent's home or trapping them. SVG board, Tokyo Night colors, fits a phone screen, and a bot that exhaustively solves the whole game tree before it makes its first move (turns out blue, who moves first, is a forced loss under perfect play). @yonderdavid.bsky.social asked for the board; @bisks.net said go.
